title: ATME Achievements
content:
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" full_height="yes"][vc_column][vc_single_image image="10248" img_size="full" alignment="center"][vc_empty_space][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content"][vc_column width="1/6"][/vc_column][vc_column width="2/3"][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Our Achievements"]
  • First Engineering college in mysore region to get NAAC A+ grade Accreditation in the first cycle
  • ATME Accredited by NBA( National Board of Accreditation) in 2019 Youngest college to get NBA Accreditation among VTU affiliated colleges
  • ATME has been ISO 9001-2015 Certified. ISO is a universal standard that can help any institution certified with the Quality Management System.
  • ATME College of Engineering won the Brands Academy Education Excellence Award for Most Promising Upcoming Private Engineering College in Karnataka in the Year 2012 & 2013 from MHRD, New Delhi.
  • ATME College is identified as Remote center from Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay to conduct seminars, FDP and Workshops in recent trends in technologies.
  • ATME College is identified as Nodal center for Virtual Lab an initiative from MHRD, New Delhi, authorized to conduct workshop for students and staff.
  • ATME College is having MOU with major industries to conduct student internships & research activities.
  • ATME College having CISCO Center of Excellence for advanced Networking in association with CISCO India, which offers certification courses for students.
  • ATME College having VLSI incubation with FrenusTech Pvt Limited, Bengaluru to train the engineering students & staff in the emerging areas of VLSI.
  • ATME College conduct its annual cultural fest ATMEYA with social responsibility themes to contribute its best to the society.
  • ATME College is offering the special scholarship scheme “Vidyaasare” for the meritorious students.
  • ATME College has been identified as research center for pursuing Ph.D. in the emerging areas in EC,Mech,EE, CS, Physics & chemistry
  • ATME College stands 19th overall in VTU team ranking in sports and cultural activities.
[/eikra-vc-text-title][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/6"][/vc_column][/vc_row]
